# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU and performance**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 adds Graphite GPU backend bindings, async pixel readback, and a broad round of managed-layer performance wins. The release brings Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn Graphite bindings, optimizes several hot paths including SKData.SaveTo and GetEncodedText, adds a SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and expands containerized test coverage to Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Upstream m151 stability fixes applied** — Three rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes merged into the bundled engine, keeping the renderer aligned with the latest stable Skia. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312))
- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Initial milestone bump to Skia m151 and cgmanifest sync landing the new engine baseline. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — New C# bindings for the Skia Graphite GPU backend, covering Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn backends, giving consumers access to the next-generation Skia rendering engine. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Async pixel readback for SKImage and SKSurface** — New RequestReadPixels API provides a backend-neutral asynchronous path for reading pixels from both images and surfaces without blocking the GPU pipeline. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **SKColor hex parsing overloads and performance** — SKColor.Parse now accepts ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, reducing allocations in parsing hot paths. Hex string parsing was also internally optimized. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **GRContextOptions unsafe modifier removed** — The unnecessary unsafe modifier was dropped from GRContextOptions, which may require minor project configuration updates for consumers using that type in unsafe contexts. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))
- **Binding generation made deterministic across platforms** — The C# binding generator now produces identical output regardless of the platform it runs on, eliminating spurious diffs in generated code. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed** — A native resource leak in the SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) overload was corrected, preventing memory growth in image-heavy workloads. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create fixed** — A CoTaskMem buffer allocated in the raster failure path of SKImage.Create was not being freed; the leak is now corrected. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **CPU raster regression restored via SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT** — A Skia upstream change disabled the legacy shader context, breaking CPU raster rendering. The flag has been restored to fix the regression. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Performance: SKData.SaveTo avoids double buffer copy** — SaveTo now streams directly from the native buffer instead of copying to a managed array first, halving memory traffic on large blobs. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **Performance: GetEncodedText null-terminated path allocation-free** — The common null-terminated code path in GetEncodedText no longer allocates an intermediate string, reducing GC pressure in text-heavy rendering loops. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))
- **Performance: SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map pre-sized** — The uniform name-lookup dictionary is now pre-sized to the known uniform count, eliminating resizing overhead for shaders with many uniforms. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))
- **Performance: SKColor/SKColorF conversion ported to managed math** — The SKColor ↔ SKColorF round-trip conversion was moved from a P/Invoke call to managed integer arithmetic, removing interop overhead from a common hot path. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370))
- **Performance: SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply ported to managed** — Single-value premultiply and unpremultiply operations are now computed in managed code rather than via native calls. ([#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **Performance: HarfBuzz Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free** — AddUtf8 now encodes strings into a pooled buffer instead of allocating a new byte array on every call. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376))
- **Performance: zero-copy spans for SKShaper glyph results** — Glyph result arrays from SKShaper are now read via Span<T> rather than copying to managed arrays, reducing allocation overhead in shaping-heavy workloads. ([#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **Performance: Tag.Parse char[4] allocation removed** — Both HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse now avoid a per-call char[4] array allocation. ([#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396))
- **Windows MSVC environment initialized once per native build** — The MSVC vcvars environment is now set up once per build job instead of once per target, reducing native build times on Windows. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## Platform

- **Nano Server gains FreeType-backed font support** — Windows Nano Server containers can now render text using the FreeType font backend, which was previously unavailable on that platform. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — A new integration package wires the Silk.NET Vulkan bindings directly to SkiaSharp's Vulkan GPU backend, simplifying Vulkan surface setup for Silk.NET users. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Containerized test legs added: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server** — The CI matrix now runs the full test suite in Azure Linux, Alpine/musl (for .NET trimming scenarios), and Windows Nano Server containers. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **WebAssembly .NET 11 support with Emscripten 5.0.6** — New Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries are included for the .NET 11 WASM target, with exception-handling support via the new exnref ABI. ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))
- **Solutions converted to .slnx format** — All Visual Studio solutions have been migrated to the new .slnx XML format for improved tooling compatibility. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))
